subject.title: fix(tailscale): auto-connect with authkey, detect NeedsLogin, enable Tailscale SSH

question: Should an auth-key-based OpenClaw installation enable Tailscale SSH by default, or require an explicit `tailscale_ssh: true` operator choice?
rationale: This changes the installer’s remote-access behavior rather than only repairing the documented auto-connect bug; the safe default is a product and security-boundary decision for repository owners.

options.title: Keep SSH opt-in
options.body: Default `tailscale_ssh` to false and document `true` as the explicit way to enable Tailscale SSH after the tailnet ACLs are reviewed.

options.title: Approve default-on SSH
options.body: Retain the default-on setting only with maintainer confirmation that enabling Tailnet SSH for all auth-key joins is an intended installer default.

recommendation.title: Keep SSH opt-in
recommendation.body: Default `tailscale_ssh` to false and document `true` as the explicit way to enable Tailscale SSH after the tailnet ACLs are reviewed.
